listDescription: Service Desk agents and their assignments, skills, and availability for ticket routing.

fields.Description: Full name of the service desk agent.
Email address of the agent, used for notifications and identity matching.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" DisplayName="Email" Required="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255" ID="{7a8b9c0d-1e2f-3a4b-5c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d}" StaticName="Email" Name="Email" Description="Email address of the agent, used for notifications and identity matching." />

<Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Department" Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{8b9c0d1e-2f3a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9a0b1c2d3e}" StaticName="Department" Name="Department" Description="Primary department this agent supports."><Default></Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>IT</CHOICE><CHOICE>HR</CHOICE><CHOICE>Operations</CHOICE><CHOICE>Finance</CHOICE><CHOICE>Facilities</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

fields.Description: Role of the agent within the service desk hierarchy.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Role" Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{9c0d1e2f-3a4b-5c6d-7e8f-9a0b1c2d3e4f}" StaticName="Role" Name="Role" Description="Role of the agent within the service desk hierarchy."><Default>Agent</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>Agent</CHOICE><CHOICE>Lead</CHOICE><CHOICE>Manager</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

fields.Description: Whether this agent is currently active and available for ticket assignment.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Boolean" DisplayName="Is Active" Required="FALSE" ID="{0d1e2f3a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a}" StaticName="IsActive" Name="IsActive" Description="Whether this agent is currently active and available for ticket assignment."><Default>1</Default></Field>

fields.Description: Maximum number of tickets this agent can be assigned concurrently.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Number" DisplayName="Max Tickets" Required="FALSE" Min="1" Max="100" Decimals="0" ID="{1e2f3a4b-5c6d-7e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b}" StaticName="MaxTickets" Name="MaxTickets" Description="Maximum number of tickets this agent can be assigned concurrently."><Default>10</Default></Field>

fields.Description: Comma-separated list of agent specialties and skill areas (e.g., Networking, Active Directory, Payroll, Benefits).
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Note" DisplayName="Skills" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="4" ID="{2f3a4b5c-6d7e-8f9a-0b1c-2d3e4f5a6b7c}" StaticName="Skills" Name="Skills" Description="Comma-separated list of agent specialties and skill areas (e.g., Networking, Active Directory, Payroll, Benefits)." />

views.query: <GroupBy Collapse="TRUE" GroupLimit="30"><FieldRef Name="Department" /></GroupBy><OrderBy><FieldRef Name="Role" Ascending="TRUE" /><FieldRef Name="Title" Ascending="TRUE" /></OrderBy>
